title: A new part sale starts with Part Sales, Service Parts or the one rep
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Three active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A}, {Sales-rep-B} and {Sales-rep-C}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able, {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able and {Sales-rep-C} is ZZAUTOTEST Cara Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has {Sales-rep-A} as its one sales representative; customer {Customer-B} shows "Sales Representative - Service Labor" {Sales-rep-A} and "Sales Representative - Service Parts" {Sales-rep-B}; customer {Customer-C} shows Service Labor {Sales-rep-A}, Service Parts {Sales-rep-B} and "Sales Representative - Part Sales" {Sales-rep-C}.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR One, {Customer-B} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Two and {Customer-C} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Three.
  • Starting screen: the Part Sales page is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Create a new part sale for {Customer-A}.
  2. Create a new part sale for {Customer-B}.
  3. Create a new part sale for {Customer-C}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: its Sales Representative field reads {Sales-rep-A}.
  • Step 2: it reads {Sales-rep-B}, the Service Parts person.
  • Step 3: it reads {Sales-rep-C}, the Part Sales person.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10890; story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives); PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S4-R26, S4-R13, read 19 Oct 2026. Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), page 2 (cited by the story), export read 19 Oct 2026, used for on-screen labels; the look itself is checked in the "Design — how it looks" cases. Source-verified 19 October 2026. The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R26: “A new part sale starts with the customer's Part Sales field when it is added: the person picked, or "Unassigned" when "Unassigned" was picked. Without a Part Sales field it starts with the Service Parts person, or the one representative when the customer is not split.”
  • S4-R13: “While the Part Sales field is not added, a change to Service Parts, or to the one representative, changes what new part sales get at once.”
